info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Refunds-v1-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Refunds API provides functionality to retrieve details about refund requests for food delivery transactions. This endpoint allows businesses and service providers to access comprehensive information on refunds associated with specific deliveries, aiding in financial tracking and customer service. Typical users include customer support teams and financial analysts who require insights into refund activity for reporting and resolution purposes. By utilizing this API, stakeholders can ensure accurate management and documentation of all refund inquiries.

get.summary: Retrieve a refund for a specific delivery.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details regarding a refund associated with a delivery. It provides information about the status, amount, and any applicable policies regarding the refund process.
